row: Welcome to Dr. Brandon Nevel's YouTube channel! Dr. Nevel is a board-certified chiropractic physician and USPTA-certified tennis professional at Sport & Spinal Rehab in Jupiter, Florida. Serving the South Florida communities of Jupiter and Palm Beach Gardens, Dr. Nevel brings advanced expertise with post-graduate certifications in chiropractic sports medicine (CCSP) and extremity care (CCEP). His unique combination of sports certifications, extremity specialization, and a chiropractic doctorate enables him to provide personalized, comprehensive care for athletes and patients alike. Subscribe to learn more about optimizing your health and performance!
